lesson: Per-element transactions contain failures; implicit state (assembly transforms) can't be trusted.
rule: Isolate risky annotation in its own transaction and verify every sheet visually. Regenerate the shop drawing whenever the assembly members are replaced: dimensions reference member faces and are deleted with them. DirectShape faces take dimension references like family geometry. Sloped faces cannot be dimensioned in an elevation chain; state the heights at both ends in a note on the view. Check the assembly frame first (FP16).
validation: PDF export rendered and reviewed per sheet
